text: Graphical setup wizard detects fresh installation and enters install mode
System requirements check (PHP version, extensions, permissions, database driver)
Database configuration form with connection testing
IMAP/SMTP configuration with connection testing and port/encryption validation
Automatic mail configuration detection for common domains
Application configuration (name, organization, domain, timezone)
Administrator account creation with strong password validation
Security configuration defaults (HTTPS, secure cookies, session lifetime, rate limiting)
Final verification suite (config, database, IMAP, SMTP, filesystem, encryption)
Installation lock prevents re-running setup on existing installation
Resumable installation state (browser close preserves progress)
Shared hosting compatible (no CLI/SSH required for installation)
User can log in with email/password via IMAP authentication
Secure application session created after successful IMAP auth
Login throttling with progressive delays after failed attempts
Session rotation after authentication
CSRF protection on all forms
Secure cookies (HttpOnly, SameSite, Secure flags)
Session invalidation on logout
TLS enforcement for IMAP/SMTP connections
MySQL/MariaDB schema for application state
Database sessions (no Redis dependency)
Application settings storage
